reasoning: The icon clearly depicts an email envelope combined with a paperclip badge, the universal symbol for an email with an attachment. It fits a very common everyday task pattern—emailing documents, forms, receipts, or photos—while remaining distinct from a plain email icon when a file is the point of the message.
